title: Home guide: the insulation test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Properties of materials and habitats (Alchemy Island and Living Things and Their Habitats)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 13 (Home practical guide and safety card: insulation test (portal worksheet; warm tap water, adult pours))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which material keeps warm water warm for longest.
equipment: Four identical cups and a measuring jug
Wool scarf, foil, paper towel or bubble wrap, elastic bands
A kitchen thermometer if you have one
safety: Warm tap water only; an adult pours it
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Wrap three cups in different materials, held with elastic bands. Leave one cup bare.
An adult pours the same amount of warm water into each cup.
Record the start temperature (or do a careful touch test).
Leave them for 20 minutes in the same place.
Record the end temperature. Which material insulated best?
